method_card.title: Mental Wellbeing and Healthy Living
method_card.content:
This lesson covers vocabulary for emotions, stress, sleep and mental wellbeing, along with structures for giving and seeking advice. (Higher tier)

FrenchEnglish
le bien-êtrewellbeing
le stressstress
stressé(e)stressed
anxieux / anxieuseanxious
se sentir bien / malto feel well / unwell
l'équilibre (m)balance
le sommeilsleep
se détendreto relax
s'épanouirto flourish / thrive (Higher)
la bienveillancekindness / wellbeing (Higher)
parler à quelqu'unto talk to someone
demander de l'aideto ask for help
il est important deit is important to
il faut + infinitiveyou must / it is necessary to

Opinion and advice structures: Je trouve que… = I think that…; il est important de + infinitive = it is important to…; il faut + infinitive = you must…; on devrait + infinitive = one should…. These are the key Higher-tier patterns for giving and discussing advice about mental health.

Subjunctive after il faut que (Higher): Il faut que tu parles à quelqu'un = You need to talk to someone (literally: it is necessary that you speak to someone). The subjunctive form of most verbs is the ils/elles present tense stem + -e, -es, -e, -ions, -iez, -ent.

Model: Je trouve que le bien-être mental est aussi important que la santé physique. Quand je me sens stressé(e), il est important de parler à quelqu'un — un ami, un membre de la famille ou un conseiller scolaire. Il faut trouver un équilibre entre le travail et les loisirs pour s'épanouir. — I think that mental wellbeing is just as important as physical health. When I feel stressed, it is important to talk to someone — a friend, a family member or a school counsellor. You must find a balance between work and leisure to thrive.
steps: Learn the key vocabulary for emotions, stress, sleep and wellbeing
Use opinion structures (je trouve que, il est important de) to express views on mental health
Practice giving advice with il faut, on devrait and il est important de
Build complex Higher-tier sentences combining opinion, advice and a subordinate clause

exam_context.frequency: Higher-tier topic — suits extended writing and conversation tasks

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Quand je suis stressé, je me détends en écoutant de la musique.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break into chunks: Quand je suis stressé | je me détends | en écoutant de la musique.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Quand je suis stressé = When I am stressed. je me détends = I relax (reflexive verb se détendre).

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: en écoutant = by listening (present participle). de la musique = some music (partitive, feminine).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: When I am stressed, I relax by listening to music.

worked_examples.question: How do you give advice in French using il est important de and il faut?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Il est important de + infinitive: Il est important de dormir suffisamment = It is important to sleep enough.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Il faut + infinitive: Il faut parler à quelqu'un = You must talk to someone.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Both structures are followed by an infinitive — never by a conjugated verb.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Use il est important de + infinitive or il faut + infinitive to give advice. Add de/d' between the expression and the infinitive.

bronze.question: Match the French wellbeing vocabulary to the English meaning
Match the French advice phrases to the English meaning
Complete the advice sentence with the correct word

gaps.correct_explain: stress = stress. Gérer le stress = to manage stress.
faut completes il faut, the impersonal structure meaning 'you must'. It is followed by an infinitive.

wrong.est: il est is part of il est important de — a different structure. Here the pattern is il faut + infinitive.

gaps.correct_explain: détendre is the infinitive of se détendre. After il faut, always use the infinitive.

wrong.détend: détend is conjugated. After il faut, use the infinitive: détendre.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence with the correct expression
sentence_parts: que le bien-être mental est très important.
important de parler à quelqu'un quand on se sent mal.

gaps.rule: Opinion verb — je + verb (I think that)
gaps.correct_explain: trouve is the je form of trouver. Je trouve que = I think that / I find that.

wrong.trouves: trouves is the tu form. For je, use trouve (no -s).

gaps.rule: Impersonal structure — il est important de
gaps.correct_explain: Il est important de = It is important to. This impersonal structure is followed by de + infinitive.

wrong.Il faut: Il faut is also correct for advice but is followed directly by the infinitive without de: Il faut parler. Here the structure uses important so we need Il est important de.

bronze.question: What does 'Il est important de trouver un équilibre entre le travail et les loisirs' mean?
options: It is important to find a balance between work and leisure
It is important to do more work than leisure
You must not work during your leisure time
It is necessary to rest at work

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly gives advice about sleep?
options: Il faut dormir suffisamment pour être en forme
Il faut dors suffisamment pour être en forme
Il faut de dormir suffisamment pour être en forme
Il faut que dormir suffisamment pour être en forme

bronze.source_text: Quand je me sens stressé, je parle à un ami ou je me promène pour me détendre.
model_answers: When I feel stressed, I talk to a friend or I go for a walk to relax.
When I feel stressed, I speak to a friend or I go for a walk to relax.
hints: quand je me sens = when I feel
je me promène = I go for a walk

bronze.question: Listen and type what you hear
bronze.audio_text: Il faut parler à quelqu'un quand on se sent mal.
bronze.correct_text: Il faut parler à quelqu'un quand on se sent mal.

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word
silver.english: I think that it is necessary to ask for help when you feel anxious.
sentence_parts: qu'il est nécessaire de demander de l'aide quand on se

gaps.rule: Opinion verb — present tense je form
gaps.correct_explain: pense is the je form of penser. Je pense que = I think that.

wrong.pensez: pensez is the vous form. For je, use pense (no ending).
wrong.pensent: pensent is the ils/elles form. For je, use pense.

gaps.rule: Reflexive verb — se sentir (on = il/elle form)
gaps.correct_explain: sent is the on/il/elle form of se sentir. On se sent anxieux = one feels anxious.

wrong.sentir: sentir is the infinitive. You need the conjugated form: on se sent.
wrong.sens: sens is the je/tu form. For on, use sent (no -s).

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Il est important de parles à un conseiller scolaire si tu te sens mal.
silver.explanation: After il est important de, use the infinitive: parler. The conjugated form parles is incorrect here.
silver.translation: It is important to talk to a school counsellor if you feel unwell.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: You should ask for help to manage stress.

distractor_labels.aide: incomplete — after de, use the full noun phrase de l'aide (de + l' + aide) because aide starts with a vowel

silver.source_text: I think that sleep is very important for mental wellbeing. You must go to bed at a reasonable time.
model_answers: Je pense que le sommeil est très important pour le bien-être mental. Il faut se coucher à une heure raisonnable.
Je trouve que le sommeil est très important pour le bien-être mental. Il faut se coucher à une heure raisonnable.
hints: at a reasonable time = à une heure raisonnable

gold.source_text: In my opinion, many young people suffer from stress because of exams. It is important to talk to someone you trust — a friend, a family member or a school counsellor. I think that finding a balance between study and leisure is essential to thrive.
model_answers: À mon avis, beaucoup de jeunes souffrent du stress à cause des examens. Il est important de parler à quelqu'un en qui on a confiance — un ami, un membre de la famille ou un conseiller scolaire. Je pense que trouver un équilibre entre les études et les loisirs est essentiel pour s'épanouir.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE French examiner marking a translation from English to French. Source: '{source}'. Model answer: '{model}'. Accept any grammatically correct translation that conveys the same meaning. Check: opinion phrases (à mon avis, je pense que), il est important de + infinitive, pour + infinitive (s'épanouir), definite article with abstract nouns. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"2-3 sentences about grammar accuracy","improvement":"optional specific correction"}

gold.question: Build the sentence in French
gold.english: I believe that it is essential to look after your mental health.

distractor_labels.son: wrong possessive — sa is used here because santé is feminine (sa santé mentale), not son
distractor_labels.important: incorrect word — this sentence uses essentiel; important would need to come after il est, not essentiel
distractor_labels.nécessaire: different meaning — nécessaire (necessary) changes the nuance; the correct word in this sentence is essentiel

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre talking to a wellness advisor about mental health and how you manage stress.

bullets.prompt: Say how you feel at the moment and whether you experience stress.
bullets.model_answer: En ce moment, je me sens assez stressé(e) à cause des examens. Je trouve que le stress peut être difficile à gérer.
bullets.note: se sentir (reflexive) + à cause de + opinion phrase (je trouve que)

bullets.prompt: Say what you do to look after your mental wellbeing.
bullets.model_answer: Pour prendre soin de mon bien-être mental, je me promène, je fais du sport et j'essaie de dormir suffisamment.
bullets.note: pour + infinitive; reflexive se promener; j'essaie de + infinitive

bullets.prompt: Ask the advisor what they recommend for managing stress.
bullets.model_answer: Qu'est-ce que vous recommandez pour gérer le stress ? Y a-t-il des activités que vous conseillez ?
bullets.note: formal question register (vous); qu'est-ce que + question; y a-t-il (is there)

bullets.prompt: Say you will try to find a better balance between study and leisure.
bullets.model_answer: Je vais essayer de trouver un meilleur équilibre entre les études et les loisirs à l'avenir.
bullets.note: near future: je vais + infinitive; meilleur (comparative of bon); à l'avenir = in the future

gold.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct subjunctive form
gold.english: It is necessary that you talk to a school counsellor if you feel unwell.
sentence_parts: à un conseiller scolaire si tu te sens mal.

gaps.correct_explain: parles is the present subjunctive of parler for tu. After il faut que, use the subjunctive: il faut que tu parles.

wrong.parler: parler is the infinitive. After il faut que + subject, use the subjunctive: que tu parles.
wrong.parlais: parlais is the imperfect. After il faut que, use the present subjunctive: parles.
